name: Laureate Education
outlook:
What Laureate Education says to expect

  • Full year 2026: total enrollmentsTotal enrollments are expected to be in the range of 518,000 to 523,000 students, reflecting growth of 4%-5% versus 2025
  • Full year 2026: revenuesRevenues are expected to be in the range of $1,920 million to $1,930 million, reflecting growth of 13% on an as-reported basis and growth of 6%-7% on a constant currency basis versus 2025
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $593 million to $599 million, reflecting growth of 14%-15% on an as-reported basis and 8%-9% on a constant currency basis versus 2025
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSAdjusted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.04 - $2.10 per share
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
